caseName: Carmichael v. Am. Express Travel Related Servs. Co.
caseNameFull: Kirk CARMICHAEL v. AMERICAN EXPRESS TRAVEL RELATED SERVICES COMPANY, INC.

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperisdenied. Petitioner allowed until February 17, 2015, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
